body:
> Hi, can you test the binaries in https://github.com/artraweditor/ART/releases/tag/nightly to see if it's better now?

Many thanks @agriggio for your reply, and for the nightly build to test.  

I have downloaded the ART-165b246-linux64.tar.xz release, and installed it to test.  

First I tested by opening the RAW file, applying the arp settings file, and then double-clicking on the image to zoom to 100%.  I did this three times, and each time the progress bar got 10% through the noise reduction (NR), then froze and crashed after 20 seconds.  

Then I tested by opening the RAW file, applying the arp settings file, and clicking on the 1:1 button to zoom in to 100%.  I did this three times:

1st time - the noise reduction got to 100%, then it froze and ART crashed 20sec later.  

2nd time - the NR progress meter flickered a few times, then slowly moved to 100%, and the image rendered at 100% magnification.  I tried moving around the image by dragging it, which worked fine, then clicked Fit to Screen and the view changed back to fit the whole image on the screen.  I then clicked the 1:1 button again, but this time the NR got to 10%, then froze and crashed.  

3rd time - as the 2nd time, the NR progress meter flickered a few times, moved to 100% and the image rendered at 100% magnification.  I tried to move around the image by dragging, but the first time I did this, the NR got stuck at 10% then ART froze and crashed.  

So I am sorry to have to report that the nightly binary does work occasionally, but not reliably  I'm afraid.  

Is there anything more I can do that would help you find what is causing this problem, please?  For instance, are there any debug outputs of ART that I could upload?
